name: @executespec/clients
description: ExecuteSpec local clients monorepo — shared core + CLI (+ VS Code extension to come).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @executespec/core && npm run build -w @executespec/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @executespec/core && npm run typecheck -w @executespec/cli
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w @executespec/core && npm run clean -w @executespec/cli
